title: Poincaré inequality on the cube Q_δ for C¹ functions, double-integral form (parent step 3)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ of class C¹, 0 ≤ δ < 1/2 and Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}. Then ∫_{Q_δ} ∫_{Q_δ} |v(x) − v(y)| dy dx ≤ (m + 1)·(1 − 2δ)·volume(Q_δ)·∫_{Q_δ} ‖Dv(x)‖ dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → 0 ≤ δ → δ < 1 / 2 → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |v x - v y| ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - 2 * δ) * (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖
